question: Do previously unintegrated predictors add useful information on top of the frozen 50/50 one/full spatial MLP blend? Test families independently; combine only independently retained additions afterward.
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, original five outer design folds, three seeds 42/43/44, all 37 cached acquisition conditions. No reserved selection/calibration/test designs, structural simulation, new physical features, GRU experiment or production-default change.

independent_families.neighborhood: Existing deterministic five-distinct-design neighborhood predictor, averaged over unchanged 107/174 feature spaces. Late fuse its point estimate with frozen blend.
independent_families.consistency: Supervised custom-objective control, global noise consistency lambda1, boundary-localized noise consistency lambda1 with abs(margin)<.05 training-pair weights. Each is independently late fused with frozen blend; never concatenate different additions in this stage. Refit on proper-fit designs because historical standalone models included the present calibration designs.
independent_families.observability: Existing global aperture/band descriptors control and global plus time-local descriptors, both with original 107/174 members averaged50/50. Test late fusion with frozen old blend, not replacement by refitted members. Reuse compatible frozen full-proper models; refit inner models on design-disjoint proper-fit subsets. No shuffled-feature family is eligible for retention.
independent_families.already_integrated: Physical joint uncertainty/soft growth integration was already completed and rejected; remains excluded. Existing one/two-mode spatial members remain inside frozen blend.

fusion.fixed: 50/50 frozen old blend and one added predictor; calibrate anew on same calibration designs. No weights selected from outer outcomes.
fusion.learned: Frozen blend plus ridge prediction of its residual. Three inner design folds within each outer proper-fit partition, same assignments as existing physical integration (default_rng(1047+outer_fold), shuffle unique proper IDs, split into3). Every base and added prediction used to train residual head is out-of-inner-design; four original acquisition views stay together. Ridge train-only scaling and unpenalized intercept; normalized LAMBDA=.1 as previous integration; no search, interaction terms, clipping, new loss or learned uncertainty scale.
fusion.matched_controls: Frozen blend; scalar blend-affine residual correction; seven-column blend-only residual correction using previous integration control [blend, one-full, feature27,28,20,19,29]. Every learned candidate appends only one added-predictor-minus-blend readout to seven-column control. Consistency candidates additionally compared with identically fused supervised custom-objective control; localized compared with global; local observability compared with global descriptors.
fusion.calibration: Identical original proper/calibration/held design splits; original four-view calibration acquisitions only. Existing absolute-residual90% intervals, design-maximum90% intervals, Gaussian-RMS probability comparator and calibration-selected1/5/10/20% false-warning budgets. No covariance/growth uncertainty addition. Frozen arm must reproduce prior saved distribution and thresholds within numerical tolerance.

optimization: Original32->16 MLP, alpha1, unchanged seeds, train-only scaling. Native L-BFGS for observability, matched custom L-BFGS for consistency. max_iter20000/max_fun400000 fixed for new fits; convergence required and warnings retained. Baseline inner predictors are reused only after source hashes, rows, design disjointness, convergence and numerical replay checks.
analysis: Per-condition complete-population and stable/unstable .01/.02/.05/far-stable slices; design MAE, signed bias, optimism>.01/.02/.03/.05, far-stable underestimation>.05; raw/group interval coverage/width, Brier, calibration-selected warning/miss tradeoffs; paired whole-design bootstrap2000 seed42 preserving seeds and acquisition pairs. Fresh iid and correlated1%/5% family means use both949/951 draws. Also report all original/mismatch conditions and seed/fold behavior. No refit uncertainty or multiplicity correction; repeated exploration on already scored acquisitions, not blind confirmation.

retention_before_combination.eligible: neighborhood; global/localized consistency; local observability. Supervised and global-observability arms are attribution controls, not independently claimed new methods.
retention_before_combination.gain: At least one fresh noise-family aggregate design-MAE improvement versus frozen blend AND corresponding matched control with paired95% upper bound below zero. For consistency require matched supervised custom control; local observability require matched global-descriptor control. Learned fusion must also improve versus seven-column blend-only control.
retention_before_combination.guardrails: Reject a route with statistically supported deterioration (paired95% lower bound above zero) in aggregate design MAE, stable/unstable last1% MAE, unstable-last1% optimism>.03, far-stable underestimation>.05, Brier or calibration5%-budget unstable-last1% miss/stable false-warning in any fresh family or clean condition. Unresolved intervals are uncertainty, not noninferiority proof; report explicitly. Retention is exploratory eligibility for combination, not production adoption.
retention_before_combination.selection: Per family prefer learned route if both pass. For consistency choose localized only with supported additional gain over global; otherwise choose global if eligible. Save immutable retention.json including independent-results hash before any cross-family fit or combination score.
retention_before_combination.final: If two or more families survive: frozen blend plus one joint cross-fitted residual ridge using control and each retained readout exactly once, same LAMBDA/calibration; compare frozen, blend-only control and retained individual routes. Also fixed equal weight between frozen blend and each retained predictor. Do not tune after combination. If one survives the final retained set equals that tested individual route; verify exact replay and state there is no cross-family combination. If none survive record that retained set is empty: existing blend unchanged, no rejected additions silently mixed.
